test_title: PYST 35: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.**

The government have a rudimentary plan for an ecosystem for defence startups to fast-forward innovation.

options.text: The government have a rudimentary plan for

solution:
The error in the sentence is: "**The government have a rudimentary plan for.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The subject "**government**" is **singular**, so the verb should also be singular. In this case, "**have**" should be corrected to "**has**" to match the singular subject "**government**."
 
• The choice between "has" and "have" depends on the subject of the sentence and its number (singular or plural).
 
• "**Has**" is used with singular subjects and the third person singular, while "**Have**" is used with plural subjects and first person (I/we) and second person (you) subjects.
 
• **Corrected sentence**: "*The government has a rudimentary plan for an ecosystem for defence startups to fast-forward innovation.*"
 
 
• "**Government**" (singular) agrees with "**has**" (singular verb).
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.
